summary.text: Scott Van Binsbergen is a Republican state representative from Minnesota who has represented House District 16A since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His career experience includes serving as president of Van Binsbergen & Associates.

paragraphs.text: Scott Van Binsbergen took office in the Minnesota House of Representatives on January 14, 2025, succeeding Dean Urdahl.
His career experience includes serving as president of Van Binsbergen & Associates.
The Republican primary for his seat on August 11, 2026, was canceled.
